subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: Should this PR become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961, with the useful schema wording from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 folded in, or should the sibling PR carry the fix?
rationale: Both branches implement the central runtime change, neither has qualifying live proof, and choosing which contributor branch should receive the final proof and review cannot be resolved safely through a three-way merge.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this branch because it has broader focused regression coverage and preserved recovery telemetry, then fold in the sibling's clearer model-facing `final` wording and add live proof.

options.title: Use the sibling PR
options.body: Move canonical review to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 if maintainers prefer its schema-guidance scope, after adding equivalent coverage and live proof.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this branch because it has broader focused regression coverage and preserved recovery telemetry, then fold in the sibling's clearer model-facing `final` wording and add live proof.
